description: Report the revocation posture of the certificate a host serves: the OCSP responder(s) and CRL distribution point(s) a client could use to check revocation, and whether the certificate is must-staple (TLS-feature status_request, forcing a stapled OCSP response). Reads these straight from the leaf certificate — it does NOT perform a live OCSP/CRL lookup, so it answers 'can revocation be checked, and how?' not 'is it revoked now?'. Complements tls_certificate. Makes only a benign TLS handshake to the target (no HTTP request); guarded against internal targets.

host.description: Host name or IP, e.g. example.com

name: cert_revocation
